# gramlot-py-server 0.3.32

- Install the `kajennspa` extra for session-backed Gramlot pages, persistent page instances, shared bindings and authorized server snapshots after reconnecting. This extra requires Gramlot 0.3.41 and Kajenn 0.10.1 or later.
- The existing `kajenn` adapter retains its installation and page-disconnect behavior.
- The repository includes a reproducible loopback benchmark for in-process and subprocess hosting, with independent controls for users, tabs and offered traffic.
